name: dsh-connector-shared
//: A library, not a DSH plugin (R-ARCH-08, design §9.1): no `dsh` field, so no bundle, row, client or service, and it never appears on a Plugins page. It is the DSH side's library (requirements 1.40, design §1.0b row 5): it holds only modules more than one DSH-side package uses, imports no other V3 package, and ships inside their tarballs through bundleDependencies (V3 publishes nothing to a registry). The Fishball side has its own library, fishball-shared; no module is shared across the sides, so ./files exists in both.
description: Modules more than one DSH-side package uses: the provider-sync wire codec, engine and host adapter, file and redaction helpers, the request-hostname rule, and the OAuth browser client (./oauth-client).
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation, as for dsh-instance: './provider-sync-codec' reads the DSH version and './provider-sync-host' adapts the pi-ai provider settings. '*' because the depending package's engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.
